rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy: SUMMIT brings true convenience to small kitchen spaces with the SCFF1842, an 18" wide fully frost-free all-freezer. The SCFF1842 is front-breathing for built-in use under counters, but also features a fully finished cabinet to allow freestanding use. The reversible door includes a factory installed lock and professional handle in stainless steel. This unit comes in a jet black finish. Inside, the SCFF1842 is fully frost-free to minimize user maintenance, with slide-out chrome shelves that can be adjusted to accommodate a variety of items in the 2.7 cu.ft. interior. This unit includes a digital thermostat for easy and intuitive temperature control. With a uniquely slim size and user-friendly features, the SCFF1842 is the ideal freezer for space-challenged spaces. This model meets UL-471 standards and is ETL-S listed to NSF-7 for use in commercial environments.

product.warranty:
Summit Warranty

SUMMIT Appliances are manufactured to provide outstanding value, and your satisfaction is our goal on every product. All SUMMIT major appliances carry a one year limited guaranty on both parts and labor. All refrigerators and freezers carry an additional four years on the compressor. Certain exclusions may apply.

Certain models (including SUMMIT Ranges, wall ovens, and cooktops) are manufactured for us in the U.S. and carry the manufacturer's warranty (also one year parts and on-site labor).

For details on specific warranty issues, please refer to the warranty packed with the product, or call our service department at 718-328-8700.

Your warranty rights are protected by mailing back the registration card packed with each refrigerator or freezer.

product.description:
A slim 18" width makes the Summit Built-In Freezer (SCFF1842SS) perfect for small homes, micro-kitchens, and small bars. Fully-finished, its flexible design means that it can fit neatly into a built-in space or stand on its own as a free-standing unit. Grab hold of its professional handle and open its sleek full-width door to reveal a 2.7 cubic-foot capacity complete with adjustable chrome shelves that'll suit your personal storage preference. Additionally, this freezer arrives equipped with a factory-installed lock for security, as well as a digital thermostat with a clear, easy-to-read LED display.

Slim 18" Width:This freezer features a slim 18" width that makes it perfect for smaller spaces

Clean, Sleek Finish:The fully finished cabinet features a clean, sleek exterior that will look great in any situation

Digital Temperature Controls:An easy-to-read LED display always shows you the temperature, set by digital controls
